description:
From: Binary Handling. Approved by the user 2026-11-24 ("proceed." on the fz-9e2.7 page https://claude.ai/artifact/3XypMCDmqCGuatQXAb5Ci9, relayed by Binary Handling).

A Kernel.== binary clause whose row (fz_op_eq_bb / fz_op_neq_bb) decides same-object and different-length inline and sends only the byte comparison to a cold call. Guard == (lower_eq_binop, receive, binop.rs) gets the same binary arm.

Acceptance: bench 07a ~90, 07c ~40, 07e ~30, 07f ~85 instructions per iteration; a fixture matching Elixir on run, interp and build.
title: Binary == is a row that calls only to compare bytes
